lesson.1.title: Introduction
lesson.1.lede: We look at what AI actually is, how models work, and why context decides everything. Practice: NotebookLM.
lesson.2.title: Claude and Code
lesson.2.lede: Working with Claude, and the terminology. Practice: a website, a lead form, a Telegram bot and a Sheets connection.
lesson.3.title: Skills and agents
lesson.3.lede: We extend what Claude can do: skills, plugins, connectors and a team of agents. Practice: build and deployment.
lesson.4.title: Agents and alternatives
lesson.4.lede: We put agents to work, look at ways to fix mistakes, and at the alternative tools. Practice: build and the final project.

prep.title: Before the first lesson
prep.intro: The first lesson is {date}. Have this list ready by then. It takes about 30 minutes in all, and it means we start working straight away in class.
prep.list.rule: Mark each item once you’ve done it.
prep.0.title: A computer
prep.0.note: A MacBook is recommended, Windows works too. A phone or a tablet is not enough.
prep.0.s0: Bring your own laptop. The praktikum is hands-on from beginning to end.
prep.0.s2: Leave at least 5 GB free on the disk.
prep.1.title: A Google account
prep.1.note: Claude, NotebookLM and Gemini all open through this account. If you already have one, you do not need a new one.
prep.1.s1: Enter your first name, last name and a new email address.
prep.1.s2: Confirm your phone number. A code arrives by SMS.
prep.1.s3: Write the password down: you will need it in class.
prep.2.title: Claude
prep.2.note: The main tool of the praktikum. Open an account on claude.ai first, then install the app.
prep.2.s0: Go to claude.ai and sign up with “Continue with Google”.
prep.2.s2: Mac: open the .dmg and drag the Claude icon into Applications.
prep.2.s3: Windows: run the .exe and confirm the installation.
prep.2.s4: Sign in to the app with that same Google account.
prep.3.title: A Visa card
prep.3.note: You will need it for a Claude Pro subscription. The free tier is enough for the first lesson.
prep.3.s0: Get an international Visa or Mastercard from your bank. Uzcard and Humo do not work here.
prep.3.s1: The card needs a dollar account with online payments enabled.
prep.3.s2: Pro costs $20 a month. It is not required, but it makes the work considerably easier.
prep.3.foot: You will need it in the later lessons.
